summary: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd (Nasdaq: GLE), a Hong Kong-based ICT solutions provider, furnished a Form 6-K on November 3, 2026, disclosing a Nasdaq notification dated October 30, 2026, confirming regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The deficiency notice had been issued October 27, 2025. Nasdaq determined compliance after the closing bid price of Class A ordinary shares stayed at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days, October 16 to October 29, 2026. The matter is now closed; no deal terms are stated. Watch for repeated bid-price pressure and any reverse-split risk.
